name: @quifox/agent-plugin-code-mode
description: Host-executed Code Mode with real Context bindings and asynchronous Tool proxies

scripts.build: bun run --filter @quifox/agent-core build && bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-composition build && bun run --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-session build && bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
